business_summary: Kimura Co.,Ltd. engages in the wholesale of building materials in Japan. The company operates through Wholesale business, Retail business, Real estate business, Scaffolding rental business, and Sash and Glass Construction business segments. The company offers, wooden building materials such as slim trim, wooden insulated entrance door, oak veneer flooring, wooden floor louvers, natural wood interior doors and windows, wooden system kitchen, and exterior lumber; energy saving includes solar power and heat exchange ventilation system; and heating and cooling offers air conditioning assist ventilation fan, far-infrared floor heating, and underfloor heating and cooling. It also provides moisture-proof and regulating airtight sheet, heat-shielding material, and foundation airtight components; healthcare includes earth plaster walls, natural humidity control and deodorizing material, Zeolite interior wall coating material, and disinfection and deodorization device; smart e-change and snow-proof air conditioner mounting bracket; hybrid roofing and resin exterior materials; acrylic waterproof and airtight tape, waterproof and breathable sheet, floor protection sheet, floor tiles, double sided tape for panels, and wall mounted storage system. In addition, the company engages in the glass, sash, and joinery work and installation; and rental and sales of real estate; and provides DIY supplies, household goods, pet supplies, leisure goods, construction, gardening supplies, interior goods, and agricultural materials. Kimura Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Sapporo, Japan.
